lines: A storm hit the front in the night. It tore the canvas off the aid post.
The orderlies held it down with their own bodies until dawn.
By morning, ninety-four Hegemony and seventy Concord had fallen.
Ninety-seven Hegemony wounded lay on stretchers. The medics reached only half of them.
Concord sniper Karel Pavla fired once through a steel loophole, and closed the shutter. Five enemies down.
Yesterday a bullet went through Matthias Coop's arm. He asked the medic if that was good. The best kind, said the medic. Today he was back.
Five soldiers bought War Bonds this week. The front thanks them.
Bone Quarry: Hegemony one hundred and thirty, Concord one hundred and seventeen.
Sixty-eight new soldiers came up the line yesterday.
Two thousand two hundred and twenty-four now hold the front.
One thousand one hundred and eighty-seven Concord.
Tonight, the raiders go out. They black their faces, and leave their letters behind.
Over the top. Through the wire. Into the enemy trench. Many will not come back.
But those who do may bring something back. Something small, hidden in the enemy mud.
Not every raider finds one. Nobody knows what it is. Not yet.
Comment RAID, and your soldier goes with them. Only the living bring it home.
